title: Liaquat and Dow Medical and Health Sciences Universities Amendment Ordinance 2006

sections.shortTitle: Liaquat and Dow Medical and Health Sciences Universities Amendment Ordinance 2006
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXVI OF 2006
ORDINANCE XXVI OF 2006
LIAQUAT AND DOW
MEDICAL AND HEALTH SCIENCES
UNIVERSITIES
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2006
An Ordinance further to
amend the Liaquat
University
of Medical and Health Sciences Ordinance, 2001 and
the Dow
University of Health
Sciences Act, 2004
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I,
27th September, 2006]
No.S.Legis:1(26)/2006,
dated 27-9-2006.---The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general
information:--
Preamble.---Whereas it is
expedient to amend the Liaquat University of Medical
and Health Sciences Ordinances, 2001 and the Dow University of Health Sciences
Act, 2004, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
And Whereas the Provincial Assembly is
not in session and the Governor of Sindh is satisfied
that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now,
therefore, in exercise
of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of
Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the
Governor of Sindh is pleased to make and promulgate
the following Ordinance:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Liaquat and Dow Medical and Health Sciences Universities
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2006.
(2) It shall come into force at once and
shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from 27th March, 2006.

And Whereas the Provincial Assembly is

Now,
therefore, in exercise
of the powers

Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the
Governor of Sindh is pleased to make and promulgate

2. Amendment of Sindh
Ordinance VIII of 2001.---In the Liaquat
University of Medical and Health Sciences Ordinance, 2001.--
(i) in section 13, for subsection (1), the following shall be
substituted:--
"(1) The Minister of Health shall be
the Pro-Chancellor of the University."
(ii) in section
14, for subsection (1), the following shall be substituted:-
"(1) Any person having medical
background shall be appointed Vice-Chancellor by the Chancellor for a period of
four years on such terms and conditions as the Chancellor may determine and
shall hold office during the pleasure of the Chancellor.";
(iii) in section
16, for subsection (1), the following shall be substituted:-
"(1) The Registrar shall be a whole-time
officer of the University and shall be appointed by the Syndicate on such terms
and conditions as it may determine,"; and
(iv) in section
19, in subsection (1), for the words "Provincial Audit Department",
the word "Syndicate" shall be substituted.

section 11, shall be renumbered as subsection (1) of that section, and

"(2) Should the Chancellor be

and

alim and one woman of eminence not serving in any
educational institution to be nominated by the Chancellor."
